python3 - ARCHIVE_PATH EXTRACTED_PACKAGE_DIRECTORY REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY <<'PY'
import csv, hashlib, json, sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
archive, refs, repo = map(Path, sys.argv[1:4])
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
canon = lambda x: json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf8')
rows = list(csv.DictReader((refs/'REFERENCE_INDEX.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig')))
mapped = json.loads((repo/'docs/production/motocross-reference-map.json').read_text())['references']
assert sha(canon(mapped)) == '7a280d79f9fa9da02d8799a32287dbb702763cd9961fd92b45d0c0d8aab63bf3'
assert [int(r['final_number']) for r in rows] == [e['number'] for e in mapped] == list(range(1,101))
images = {}
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
 assert z.testzip() is None
 for row, entry in zip(rows, mapped):
  assert row['file'] == entry['file'] and entry['id'] == f"{entry['number']:03d}"
  for key in row.keys() - {'final_number','category','file'}: assert row[key] == entry['suppliedMetadata'][key]
  raw = (refs/row['file']).read_bytes(); images[row['file']] = sha(raw)
  assert images[row['file']] == row['sha256']
  assert z.read(refs.name+'/'+row['file']) == raw
  with Image.open(refs/row['file']) as image:
   image.load(); assert image.size == (int(row['width']),int(row['height']))
assert len(images) == len(set(images.values())) == 100
paths = sorted({p for e in mapped for p in e['implementation']['files']})
assert all((repo/p).is_file() for p in paths)
evidence = repo/'docs/production/motocross-evidence'
new_rendered = {'compatibility/r31-r4':14,'bike/r31-r4':21,'validation/shared-crowd':8}
registered = 0
for rel in ['world','interface','compatibility/r2-interface','compatibility/r2-environment','gameplay',*new_rendered]:
 p = evidence/rel; record = json.loads((p/'visual-review.json').read_text()); review = record['images']
 registered += len(review)
 assert len(review) == len({i['file'] for i in review})
 assert {i['file'] for i in review} == {f.name for f in p.glob('*.png')}
 assert all(sha((p/i['file']).read_bytes()) == i['sha256'] for i in review)
 if rel == 'gameplay':
  expected = {f'{venue}-actual-{view}.png' for venue in ['valley-ridge-mx','arena-nord-sx'] for view in ['menu','chase','onboard','pause']}
  assert {i['file'] for i in review} == expected
  assert all(i.get('reviewed') is True and isinstance(i.get('observation'),str) and i['observation'].strip() for i in review)
  run = json.loads((p/'test-run.json').read_text()); env = json.loads((p/'environment.json').read_text())
  assert record['sourceFilesSha256'] == run['source']['sourceSha256'] == env['sourceSha256'] == '7733bb95ae33dc962eb2e6d07b2d3480dac3276a50753733268a68b22f500d36'
  assert record['buildFingerprintSha256'] == run['source']['buildIdentity']['fingerprint'] == env['buildIdentity']['fingerprint'] == '82b5018336f9fb2c9ae1c2fcc7d11d1c3011209ec2e1c8471be5111c033c52e8'
  assert run['source']['sourceCount'] == 667 and record['testSource'] == run['sourceSpec']
  attachments = {i['retainedHereAs']:i for i in run['attachments'] if i.get('contentType')=='image/png'}
  assert set(attachments) == expected
  assert all(i['sha256'] == attachments[i['file']]['sha256'] and (p/i['file']).stat().st_size == attachments[i['file']]['bytes'] for i in review)
 if rel in new_rendered:
  run = json.loads((p/'test-run.json').read_text())
  assert len(review) == new_rendered[rel] and run['source']['sourceCount'] == 670
  assert record['testRunSha256'] == sha((p/'test-run.json').read_bytes())
  assert record['sourceFilesSha256'] == run['source']['sourceSha256'] == 'acfc1a799a933ff9c135046aee17daa741366549f7808b8091200accf69f874d'
  assert record['buildFingerprintSha256'] == run['source']['buildIdentity']['fingerprint'] == 'a5a1575e169f6475439722adeb3ac6ae569bc91b6d604f14e465faf7eccc6de4'
  assert record['testSource'] == (run.get('source_spec') or run.get('sourceSpec'))
  assert all(i.get('reviewed') is True and i.get('method')=='individual-display' and isinstance(i.get('observation'),str) and i['observation'].strip() for i in review)
  rows = json.loads((p/'attachment-manifest.json').read_text()) if (p/'attachment-manifest.json').is_file() else run['images']
  attachments = {i.get('file') or i.get('retainedHereAs'):i for i in rows if (i.get('file') or i.get('retainedHereAs','')).endswith('.png')}
  assert set(attachments) == {i['file'] for i in review}
  assert all(i['sha256'] == attachments[i['file']]['sha256'] and (p/i['file']).stat().st_size == attachments[i['file']]['bytes'] for i in review)
 for item in review:
  assert Path(item['file']).name == item['file']
  with Image.open(p/item['file']) as image:
   image.load(); assert image.format == 'PNG'
   if rel == 'gameplay' or rel in new_rendered or 'width' in item: assert image.size == (item['width'],item['height'])
assert registered == 90
print(json.dumps({'references':len(mapped),'registeredEvidenceImages':registered,'uniqueMappedPaths':len(paths),'normalizedReferencesSha256':sha(canon(mapped)),'sourceImageManifestSha256':sha(canon(images)),'csvSha256':sha((refs/'REFERENCE_INDEX.csv').read_bytes()),'archiveSha256':sha(archive.read_bytes())},indent=2))

Hash bytes only after an original-image/source-archive size match; inspect ZIP member sizes and matching member bytes. Match against all 100 CSV sha256 values and the original ZIP sha256.
